episode.logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
episode.continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory):
events.text: "You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

events.label: RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious):
events.text: "The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving):
events.text: "The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

events.label: RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid):
events.text: "She knows the Duchess was poisoned."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

events.label: RUPERT (Fearful):
events.text: "If she speaks..."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous):
events.text: "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

events.label: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive):
events.text: "What are you suggesting?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous):
events.text: "We stop hiding the prisoner."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister):
events.text: "We give them a reason to condemn her."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

events.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp):
events.text: "You have a solution?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless):
events.text: "We use the law to destroy her."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

events.label: RUPERT (Confused):
events.text: "The law?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Pragmatic, Scheming):
events.text: "A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating):
events.text: "Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

events.label: CATHERINE (Curious, Conniving):
events.text: "And if she claims she is a healer?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Sinister):
events.text: "Then call it witchcraft."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.

events.label: RUPERT (Stunned):
events.text: "Witchcraft is a capital charge."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching):
events.text: "Precisely."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command):
events.text: "Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.

events.label: CATHERINE (Scheming):
events.text: "Her botanical ledger..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Confirming):
events.text: "Exactly."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

events.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring):
events.text: "And the Dowager?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive):
events.text: "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.

events.label: RUPERT (Hesitant):
events.text: "And Juliana?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute):
events.text: "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.

events.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant):
events.text: "She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.

events.label: RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful):
events.text: "I will write the arrest warrant myself."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.

events.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive):
events.text: "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: High-angle shot peering down through the heavy iron dungeon grate into the flooded, pitch-black subterranean wet cells where water drips continuously.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Echoing, hollow water droplets splashing into dark pools beneath stone vaults, accompanied by a somber orchestral swell.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium shot pushing in on Juliana huddled against the wet stone wall, chained by the wrists, shivering in wet rags as faint moonlight filters down through the grate above.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
